content.title: Canada's Brookfield to buy UK's Just Group for $3.2 billion
content.summary: Under the deal, Just Group shareholders will receive 220 pence per share, a 75% premium to the stock's closing price on July 30, BWS said on Thursday.  Just Group shares jumped 69% to 213 pence in early trading, its highest since March 2014.
